caption:
Figure 3. Overview of CUPID’s pipeline. From a single input image, CUPID first generates an occupancy and a UV cube in canonical
space. Then, a Perspective-n-Point (PnP) solver (i.e., Eq. 2) recovers the camera pose. Using this recovered camera pose, we extract pose-
aligned conditioning latents and visual features (i.e., Eq. 3), along with noisy structured latents, to generate the geometry and appearance
features, which will be decoded to the 3D Gaussian splats and mesh.
delegated_acceptance_review: Actually viewed the final CUPID diagram and reviewed caption, Section 3.2/3.3 evidence, and independent source-pair checks. The complete scientific figure is preserved at 2x source pixels, including robot, occupancy/UV cubes, latent, camera schema, all conditioning paths, module symbols and output examples. The two added callouts describe UV 3D-2D correspondences/PnP and pose-aligned DINO plus low-level feature fusion with noisy voxel features, directly supported by Equations 2-3 and the supplied paragraphs. No new conditioning edge or decoder connection appears. The figure is an annotation/layout intervention with the entire original scientific diagram preserved.
